purpose: 표준(글로벌)·웹사이트 표면에서 어떤 프롬프트의 답변들이 자사(owned) URL 을 인용했는지, 어떤 프롬프트는 인용은 있으나 자사 URL 이 전혀 없는지(uncited)를 프롬프트 단위로 갈라 보여준다. 각 프롬프트의 인용 수·응답 엔진·퍼널 단계·대표 답변 표본을 함께 제공해, "우리 콘텐츠가 어느 프롬프트에서 인용되고 어느 프롬프트에서 빠지는지"를 드릴다운으로 확인하게 한다.
query_design:
"핵심 변화: 현행은 owned 판정을 조회 시 URL 정규화+prefix 정규식(citationOwnedBaseSql)으로 매번 계산했지만, 새 구조는 적재 시점에 rd.citation.owner_key 로 이미 채워져 있어(P1) 조회는 단순 허용집합 매칭이 된다.

STEP0 (요청 1회, 캐시 가능하지 않지만 저렴): 허용 owner_key 집합
SELECT owner_key FROM app.owned_base WHERE brand_code = :own_brand;  -- 수십 행

STEP1 CTE 전개(파티션 prune: surface, round_date):
WITH scoped_answer AS (
  SELECT a.answer_key, a.prompt_key FROM rd.answer a
  WHERE a.surface = :surface AND a.round_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
    AND a.project_key = ANY(:project_keys)      -- own_brand ∪ HMG 공통 프롬프트 모집단(§4 규칙3)
    AND (:engine_keys IS NULL OR a.engine_key = ANY(:engine_keys))
    AND (:geo_keys    IS NULL OR a.geo_key    = ANY(:geo_keys))
    AND (:lang_keys   IS NULL OR a.lang_key   = ANY(:lang_keys))  -- website 전용
    AND a.cit_in
), scoped_prompt AS (   -- brand[]/funnel[]/brand_presence[]/list_type[]/depth1-3[] 있을 때만 조인
  SELECT DISTINCT ce.prompt_key FROM rd.catalog_entry ce
  WHERE (:brand_bits IS NULL OR ce.brand_bit = ANY(:brand_bits))
    AND (:funnel_keys IS NULL OR ce.funnel_key = ANY(:funnel_keys))
    AND (:presence_keys IS NULL OR ce.presence_key = ANY(:presence_keys))
    AND (:list_type_keys IS NULL OR ce.list_type_key = ANY(:list_type_keys))
    AND (:depth1_keys IS NULL OR ce.depth1_key = ANY(:depth1_keys))
), pr AS (
  SELECT c.prompt_key, count(*)::int AS cites,
         array_agg(DISTINCT c.engine_key) AS engine_keys,
         bool_or(c.owner_key = ANY(:allowed_owner_keys)) AS owned
  FROM rd.citation c
  JOIN scoped_answer sa ON sa.answer_key = c.answer_key
  WHERE c.surface = :surface AND c.round_date BETWEEN :from AND :to AND c.cit_in
    AND (:source_category_keys IS NULL OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM rd.dim_source ds WHERE ds.source_key = c.source_key
             AND ds.category_key = ANY(:source_category_keys)))
    AND (:has_catalog_filter = false OR c.prompt_key IN (SELECT prompt_key FROM scoped_prompt))
  GROUP BY c.prompt_key
)
-- (A) 탭 카운트(양쪽 버킷 동시)
SELECT owned, count(*)::int AS prompts FROM pr GROUP BY owned;

-- (B) 페이지 목록(키셋, cites DESC, prompt_key DESC 타이브레이크)
SELECT pr.prompt_key, dp.prompt_id, dp.text, dp.funnel_key, pr.cites, pr.engine_keys
FROM pr JOIN rd.dim_prompt dp ON dp.prompt_key = pr.prompt_key
WHERE pr.owned = :owned
  AND (:cursor_cites IS NULL OR (pr.cites, pr.prompt_key) < (:cursor_cites, :cursor_prompt_key))
  AND (:q IS NULL OR dp.text ILIKE '%' || :q || '%')
ORDER BY pr.cites DESC, pr.prompt_key DESC
LIMIT :limit;

-- (C) 페이지에 실린 prompt_key 들의 답변 표본(상위 8, CITATION_SPLIT_REFS 계승)
SELECT prompt_key, answer_key, engine_key, geo_key, cites FROM (
  SELECT c.prompt_key, c.answer_key, j.engine_key, j.geo_key, count(*)::int AS cites,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.prompt_key ORDER BY count(*) DESC, c.answer_key) AS rk
  FROM rd.citation c JOIN rd.job j ON j.answer_key = c.answer_key
  WHERE c.prompt_key = ANY(:page_prompt_keys) AND c.cit_in
  GROUP BY c.prompt_key, c.answer_key, j.engine_key, j.geo_key
) t WHERE rk <= 8;

쓰기 API 아님(읽기 전용) — 절차 항목 해당 없음."
